articles.title: Where Did Bats Come From? Scientists Point to Europe
articles.summary: A huge international team studied bat DNA and fossils. They say bats most likely began in Europe about 65 to 60 million years ago, then spread around the world.

articles.title: New Fabric "Plant Armor" Helps Strawberries Grow More Fruit
articles.summary: A new fabric cover keeps insects off strawberry plants but lets sunlight, rain and air through. In tests it helped plants make much more fruit.

articles.title: Eating Plan Linked to Slower Brain Aging, Study Finds
articles.summary: People who followed the MIND diet more closely lost brain tissue more slowly over about 12 years. The study found a link, but it does not prove food is the cause.
